additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
We have received an issue report from a customer stating that the main breaker QA1 has tripped. We kindly request you to coordinate a site intervention for this charger. Please adhere to the troubleshooting steps outlined in the attached document. Additionally, if feasible, arrange for spare components so that if the current ones are damaged, we can replace them and restore the charger to operational status.
Additionally, please find below knowledge article for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Braeker,QA1_Mainbreaker QA1 error - Dynamics 365
